notes: Silicon rock: dark grey-blue rock with cleaved, glassy faces that catch the light. Drops silicon 1-2. Frames are the piece turned [0, 90, 180, 270] degrees, lit from the top-left each time; loop them wrap (`wrap` = 1,2,3,4,1... ; `pingpong` = 1,2,3,4,3,2,...), the game may also rotate the node.
